title: pinus nephrolepis
intro: Pinus nephrolepis, commonly known as White or Japanese Red Pine, is a species of evergreen coniferous tree native to East Asia. The health benefits of Pinus nephrolepis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, and its analgesic properties, which can help to alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of Pinus nephrolepis include pinosylvin, pinobanksin, and bornyl acetate, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
